mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are enjoying clear skies and a comfortable 78 degrees out at Verona City Hall, with a waning crescent moon overhead.

There are some great initiatives in town. The City of Verona continues its contract with AECOM for engineering updates, while the Senior Center is offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those looking to enjoy the scenery.

There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at both Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's all happening today. Looking ahead, you can check out the Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly report, on Thursday, July 30, a driver was pulled over for an equipment violation, which resulted in an arrest for O W I along with citations for suspended registration.
Today is the perfect day to head over to Culver's for the Andes Mint Avalanche. They are open until 10:30 PM, so stop by and enjoy a delicious treat!
